All other breadth courses are forbidden or blocked: CS4263 precludes completed CS2109S; CS5339 requires forbidden CS3244/CS3264 or CG3201, which also precludes CS2109S. The 64-unit programme_lower requirement likewise reaches at most 58 units. Thus no four-semester plan can satisfy every requirement."}
